failure_sensitivity_AUC.scope: score-bound sensitivity over all 31 selected held-out inputs, not confidence intervals or imputed results

interpretation: Weak exploratory single-reference/single-conformer assay discrimination; 23/25 evaluable scores are tied at zero. No predictive, binding-affinity, series-independent or full LIT-PCBA claim. No held-out optimization.

attribution.scope: Actual enclosing Ackredit capture plus native per-result payloads; reviewed LIT-PCBA literature is cited separately.

input_retention.redistribution: No raw Bath archive or PubChem SDF redistribution; URLs/hashes and attributed selected labels committed. Strict restore requires exact source bytes and fails closed on upstream refresh; retained originals are needed if the upstream response changes.

environment.origin: ordinary fresh public Conda environment, 311 records retained in full result
environment.scope: local scientific pilot, not a new release qualification
environment.state: Owned isolated prefix retired after successful completed run; originals, archives, receipts and public recreation command retained. No shared environment/cache modified by cleanup.

limits: One deterministic reference and a small selected evaluation cohort.
Only exact CID leakage is controlled; chemical-series overlap is unqualified.
One supplied PubChem computed conformer, not a verified bound pose or conformer-ensemble search.
The emitted query contains two acceptors and one aromatic site; no donor is emitted.
Six failures excluded from measured metrics; hypothetical sensitivity is separate.
Only declared triplet proposal enumeration is complete; no guarantee of exhaustive continuous pose/conformer search.
No inferential uncertainty interval or computational-performance comparison.

prior_control_attempts: Initial administrative discovery lacked explicit SDK location; retried with accepted SDK.
First SDK control run exposed namespace import pollution from the new archive guard; fixed standalone-reader loading, preserving clean support staging.

subsequent_ranking_qualification.scope: Separate source probe confirms frame-dependent partial negative coverage; original frozen public-runtime assay scores remain unchanged and cannot be promoted to demonstrated frame-independent molecular ranking.
